svg.title: FP8 values for a weight row
svg.text: FP8 for one real weight row (layer 14, down_proj): the grid follows the weights
Gray: how many of the row's weights have each value (square-root scale). Teal: the 253 values an FP8
byte can hold once the row is scaled so its largest weight lands on 448. Each is within 1/16 of the
weight it replaces: the error is relative, small for small weights and larger for the few large ones.
